changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwfamilyhistory AS SELECT fh.id, fh.patient_id, fh.condition, fh.relation, fh.inherited_diseases, fh.created_by, fh.created_date, fh.last_modified_by, fh.last_modified_date, fh.status, fh.cancelled_by, fh.cancelled_date, fh.cancellation_reason FROM public.family_history fh;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwfamilyhistory TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwfamilyhistory FROM report_user;
